reviews.title: Why pay?
reviews.text: Why do I have to pay for something to help me lose weight? It doesn’t make any sense to me

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: I’ve had this app about five minutes and I was stupid to pay for it. I’ve never used a more difficult and frustrating app. You have no control at all and you cannot reset a fast if it’s logged wrong or starts at the incorrect time. Rip off!

reviews.title: Negative
reviews.text: Used the word lazy in a notification to me. Wow!!! I wish I could get a refund. How negative and awful.

reviews.title: Not impressed with the subscription push.
reviews.text: I had used this app for years without a subscription, but had a lapse of usage, so when I went to log back on, it wouldn’t even let me log in without signing up for a subscription. I don’t appreciate the fact that it now is mandatory, when I was perfectly fine with the free version. Will not be using again.
